title: Design System: OfficeLab Repository global screens

shadows.name: creation-button
shadows.purpose: Subtle edge on creation buttons; panels and cards remain flat.

components.name: Creation button
components.description: Repository creation treatment on the shared Button; compact representative preview.
components.css: .ds-create { font: 500 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--repository-action, #1f883d); color: white; border: 1px solid rgb(31 35 40 / 15%); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(31 35 40 / 4%); cursor: pointer; } .ds-create:hover { background: var(--repository-action-hover, #1a7f37); } .ds-create:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring, #0969da); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-create { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Repository search
components.description: Labeled search with an inline SVG icon and Repository focus treatment.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"/></svg><input aria-label="Search repositories" placeholder="Search repositories" /></label>
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: block; } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; left: 10px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #59636e); pointer-events: none; } .ds-search input { font: 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px 0 32px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d1d9e0); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-background, #ffffff); color: var(--color-foreground, #1f2328); caret-color: var(--color-primary, #0969da); } .ds-search input:hover { border-color: var(--color-border-strong, #d1d9e0); } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring, #0969da); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-search input { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Active navigation
components.description: Current global destination uses a blue indicator, neutral fill, and semibold text.
components.html: Home
components.css: .ds-nav { padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--color-foreground, #1f2328); text-decoration: none; font: 600 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--color-accent, #818b981a); } .ds-nav a[aria-current='page']::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -10px; top: 7px; bottom: 7px; width: 3px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--color-primary, #0969da); } .ds-nav svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring, #0969da); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 720px) { .ds-nav a { min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Metadata label
components.description: Noninteractive outlined metadata label; text in this preview is illustrative.
components.css: .ds-label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 7px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d1d9e0); border-radius: 20px; font: 500 12px/20px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--color-muted-foreground, #59636e); }

components.name: Pages discovery card
components.description: Empty-dashboard Pages entry links to the directory without fabricated content or thumbnails.
components.html: PagesView all
components.css: .ds-page { display: block; padding: 20px; background: var(--color-surface, #f6f8fa); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #d1d9e0); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--color-foreground, #1f2328); text-decoration: none; font: 14px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-page:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary, #0969da); } .ds-page:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ring, #0969da); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-page > svg { display: block; color: var(--color-primary, #0969da); width: 28px; height: 28px; margin-bottom: 20px; } .ds-page strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-page span { display: block; margin-top: 16px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--color-primary, #0969da); }

narrative.overview:
The user selected GitHub Dashboard and requested high GitHub fidelity. OfficeLab uses its compact navigation, system typography, neutral borders, blue links, and green creation actions across the dashboard and global directories.

Scope: dashboard, repositories, global Pull Requests and Issues, Recent, and Pages. Wiki and editor iframe appearance have separate owners. The existing shared UI primitives supply controls and overlays; Repository styles specialize their chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, readable navigation and metadata-led lists.
Flat bordered surfaces in light and dark themes.
Real resource metadata and explicit query states.
dos: Do retain the selected GitHub Dashboard direction and OfficeLab identity.
Do apply the light or dark token set consistently within Repository global chrome.
Do preserve accessible labels, visible keyboard focus, and mobile touch targets.
Do display real metadata and distinguish loaded counts from totals.
donts: Don't restyle Wiki or Office/HTML iframe content through these tokens.
Don't invent activity metrics, Page thumbnails, or preview content.
Don't add raster artwork or replace existing shared UI primitives.
